name: x11-background-computer-use
description: Parallel claimed-window capture and guarded same-session input for EWMH Xorg desktops.

interface.shortDescription: Background capture and guarded control for Xorg.
interface.longDescription: Extends Computer Use on local EWMH Xorg sessions with expiring per-agent window claims, parallel exact XComposite capture, per-window best-effort no-focus shortcuts, and one explicitly acknowledged, journaled global-seat lease for reliable XTEST input. Supports Xfce, Cinnamon, MATE, LXQt/Openbox, and legacy GNOME or KDE Xorg sessions when their window manager exposes EWMH.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing logged-in X11 app to complete this task.
Capture an exact unobscured screenshot of one of my real X11 windows.
Operate this Xorg app and restore my focus and pointer when finished.
